text: BAM share rose 1.2 percentage points over 26 hours and 0.84 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.8%. Concentration is elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 4. The 68 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, while new ams and tyo precursor signals do not by themselves establish a structural rollover.
